description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%) for different editing methods applied to LLMs. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. The line labeled “Base” is black with circular markers and begins at approximately (1, 63) and ends at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 67). The line labeled “MEND” is brown with diamond markers and starts at approximately (1, 68) and ends at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 73). The line labeled “FT” is blue with triangular markers, commencing at approximately (1, 64) and terminating at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 71). The line labeled “MEMIT” is purple with square markers, starting at approximately (1, 69) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 74). The line labeled “IKE” is red with downward-pointing triangular markers, beginning at (1, 66) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 70). Finally, the line labeled “ROME” is green with square markers, starting at approximately (1, 72) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 78).
